title.zh: 【Backpack：代币化股票累计交易额超 50 亿美元，预测市场和支付卡已完成内测】
title.en: 【Backpack：代币化股票累计交易额超 50 亿美元，预测市场和支付卡已完成内测】

current_state.zh: Backpack disclosed on an investor call that its tokenized-stock offering has surpassed $5 billion in cumulative trading volume across 73 listed tokenized stocks, while prediction markets and a payment card have completed internal testing and a second securities market is in product preparation, alongside expansion plans in Japan and a pending partnership in South Korea.
